description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

1Password is hiring a Junior Developer for its Data Security team. The role develops and maintains cryptographic libraries and security features, implements industry specifications, and helps ensure cryptographic standards across its products.
Security software developer building cryptographic libraries, designing security features, and remediating application vulnerabilities

Responsibilities:
• Work with a small team of security developers who are specialists in Rust and Golang Security
• Develop cryptographic or other security libraries to share common security-critical code across our applications
• Assist in security design efforts or scoping initiatives for new features, particularly with heavy cryptographic components
• Assess and take appropriate steps to resolve new security vulnerabilities across our applications
• Implement new security features for the next generation of 1Password
• Demonstrate leadership in security development and act as a trusted point of contact for management and other developers
• Work with a variety of teams across our hybrid core architecture, including Design, Product and Product Engineering

Requirements:
• You have 0-2+ years of experience in software development
• You have a passion for and strong experience with security development best practices, coding standards, and design patterns
• You have a basic understanding of modern cryptographic algorithms, trade-offs and implementation considerations gained from real world experience
• You work well in a team environment with positive communications amongst a variety of technical and non-technical stakeholders
• You have proven experience in implementing testing methodologies and debugging techniques to ensure high-quality code
• You're adaptable and resilient, thriving in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities

Preferred:
• Experience with implementing industry standards into new libraries or codebases
• Experience with Rust and/or Golang, or a demonstrated ability to pick up new languages quickly

Pay: $100K/yr - $140K/yr
